name: Loading Room
summary: In Gnomeregan's depths, the Loading Room is a dangerous place to pass through. The ruined chamber once staged cargo for the city's transit networks, but radioactive fallout and rogue machinery now threaten anyone who enters.

sections.title: Industrial Depot Under Siege
sections.body: The Loading Room once handled cargo for Gnomeregan's underground transit network. Before the city fell, goods passed through its staging bay on their way across the tinker capital. Now the room is caught in the ruin that has overtaken Gnomeregan. Radioactive fallout, invading troggs, and failing machinery make the area perilous. Techbot, a rogue mechanized construct, guards the vicinity. Gnome survivors and Alliance reclaimers who try to secure the perimeter must face that danger.

faq.q: What is the Loading Room used for?
faq.answer: The Loading Room once staged cargo for Gnomeregan's internal transport and train facilities. Since the city fell, hazards have overrun this lost sector.

faq.q: What threats can be found in the Loading Room?
faq.answer: Techbot, a rogue mechanical defense construct, prowls the Loading Room. Radioactive contamination and erratic machinery also threaten anyone in this part of the city.

faq.q: Is the Loading Room safe to explore?
faq.answer: No. The Loading Room lies in contested ground among Gnomeregan's ruins. Alliance strike teams entering the complex face hostile constructs and toxic conditions.

angles.text: For gnomish reclaimers, the Loading Room recalls how ordinary city works were abandoned during the trogg invasion and toxic catastrophe.
Techbot and the remaining mechanical assemblies in the Loading Room show engineers the danger of automated defenses left without maintenance.
